projects.name: pointintime
projects.description: A bitemporal feature store in which point-in-time correctness is enforced by the read API. A static leakage detector quarantines a deliberately planted future-leaking feature, and a train/serve skew check compares offline and online values.
highlights: A naive latest-value join scores 0.912 AUC offline against 0.654 on production inputs; honest point-in-time features score 0.701
Knowledge-time watermark gives 0 / 40000 skew mismatches versus 3492 (8.73%) for the event-time bug
59 tests covering the store, detector, registry gate and materialiser

projects.name: labelbudget
projects.description: An active-learning benchmark that reports labels needed to reach a target accuracy, with variance across many seeds and a prominent random-sampling baseline. A comparison guard refuses to declare a winner the evidence does not support.
highlights: Shows one seed claiming uncertainty sampling is 4.2x better while another shows random 2.1x better
Paired bootstrap CI and exact sign test over 30 seeds; no comparative claim below 10 seeds
Converts label budgets into cost at $90/hour and 6 min/label

projects.name: sliceguard
projects.description: A fairness slice auditor that puts Wilson and Newcombe intervals on every slice, applies Benjamini-Hochberg correction and reports a minimum detectable effect, so tiny slices stop producing false alarms.
highlights: Audits 6,000 synthetic underwriting-model evaluations with two planted 9-point disparities
A 19-person slice topping the raw-gap ranking is correctly marked INDETERMINATE
Ranks slices by the lower bound of the gap interval at a default q = 0.05

projects.name: fieldvoice
projects.description: An offline speech-to-structured-report pipeline evaluated on entity error rate rather than word error rate, with catalogue-constrained decoding that snaps part numbers and fault codes or routes them to a human.
highlights: Demonstrates a ranking flip: WER 0.192 vs 0.231 prefers System A, entity error rate 0.833 vs 0.000 prefers System B
Typed extraction of part IDs, fault codes, quantities with units, dates and locations
80 tests, including a check that the pipeline runs with networking disabled

projects.name: cuped
projects.description: A CUPED variance-reduction library for A/B tests that refuses covariates measured after randomisation, using a declared-window check plus a balance test across arms.
highlights: Valid pre-period covariate removes 38.7% of variance: an 11-week test becomes a 7-week one
Blocks a post-treatment covariate that removes 98.3% of variance but returns an effect of -6.601 against a true 1.80
Seeded run on 30,000 synthetic customers with heavy-tailed revenue

projects.name: mixpriors
projects.description: A Bayesian media mix model with informative adstock and Hill saturation priors and a hand-written Metropolis-Hastings sampler. Its budget optimiser maximises expected return across all posterior draws.
highlights: 9/9 true channel values inside their 90% intervals on 156 weeks of synthetic data
Posterior-aware plan scores +2.77% on the true curves versus -1.18% for the point-estimate shortcut
Browser lab deployed to GitHub Pages for risk-penalised allocation

projects.name: geolift
projects.description: Geo incrementality testing by synthetic control with a pre-period fit gate and placebo inference, plus a browser demo of the gate-then-placebo decision.
highlights: Estimates +4.28% lift against a planted 4.0%, where a before/after comparison reports -22.3%
Refuses fits whose pre-period RMSE exceeds 5.5% of scale and lifts below the detection floor
Placebo inference over 15 donors gives p = 0.062

projects.name: metricregistry
projects.description: A KPI registry where each metric is stored as versioned, executable SQL with an owner and grain, and a divergence monitor alerts when metrics meant to match drift apart.
highlights: Flags three enrolment definitions up to 6.80% apart against a 0.50% tolerance
Stays silent when definitions agree, as with two application counts of 17,100
16 tests check definitions against independent ground-truth counts

projects.name: surgecapacity
projects.description: A discrete-event simulation of emergency department staffing across five triage categories and seasonal demand, reporting p95 wait and breach probability instead of the mean, validated against closed-form M/M/c results.
highlights: Demand-shaped roster cuts p95 wait from 4.42h to 2.05h on the same 1,512 clinician-hours per week
A 25% surge lifts the four-hour breach rate from 6.4% to 14.9% on the flat roster
Simulator validated against analytic Erlang C wait quantiles
